## Weekly Update - 2026-09-13

Hey <@&1424461167883194418> — 96 PRs merged. The garden has acquired a shell.

🤖 **Agents got proper elbow room**
- Managed code agents now have a persistent per-user filesystem + `bash` via [Computer MCP](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/pull/14741).
- Agent prompt/tool-call limits are now 3× larger, with clearer failure statuses and tool results returned as content parts.
- MCP also gained device-flow login and structured call errors.

🎞️ **Media routes are converging**
- Media models now work through both Chat and Responses, including image inputs.
- Generated files use media storage, old cached media can be recovered on demand, and MCP reuses generated media URLs.
- `minimax/h3-max-turbo` can now render at 1080p; paid users can access GPT Image 2.5 models.

🧭 **Models, usage, and keys got less ambiguous**
- Canonical model names, provider mappings, permissions, and community model IDs got a serious cleanup.
- You can define your own fallback chains; Perplexity Sonar and Grok video routing have stronger fallbacks.
- The dashboard now has usage/earnings breakdowns, independent activity charts, and top-up/key-editor links from `402` notices.

🌱 **Also sprouting:** `embeddings()` in the SDK, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GIMP 3 BYOP generation/editing, and a steadily growing app registry.

Streams, caches, billing usage, and error diagnostics also received the sort of attention that prevents future archaeology. [Docs](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/APIDOCS.md) · [GitHub](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations)
